description: This file implements a calendar handling module for an Android application, providing functionalities to retrieve and add calendar events with permission validation and JSON parsing.

classes.name: CalendarHandler
classes.description: Main class for handling calendar operations including fetching and adding events.

classes.name: CalendarDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for interacting with calendar data, including permission checks and CRUD operations.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters for fetching calendar events.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters for adding a new calendar event.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event's data as retrieved or created.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Handles the process of retrieving calendar events based on JSON parameters, including permission checks.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new calendar event based on JSON parameters, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: parseEventsRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input to create a CalendarEventsRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input to create a CalendarAddRequest object.

methods.name: parseISO
methods.description: Parses ISO date strings to Instant objects.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEventRecord to a JSON object for output.
